verdict: The B4/LRU4 specialization, M1866 selection authority, immutable M1794/M803 identities, arithmetic/resource ledgers, contract boundaries, and official CPython 3.6/3.12 checks are internally consistent. M1872 is not authorized. The producer checker recognizes explicit B4/cache ledger mutations but accepts all 15 independent vocabulary-preserving semantic attacks against replay identity/payload, replay fail-closed checking, reset recovery, complete post-reset service, the local cycle gate, context-range assertions, request stability, and the recovery cover.

findings.title: The source checker is vocabulary-based for the repaired replay, recovery, SVA, and cycle-gate obligations
findings.evidence: The independent CPython 3.6/3.12 probe made 15 syntax-preserving, vocabulary-preserving semantic mutations. It replaced saved replay slot/generation/tag/payload with constants; neutralized replay sticky-fault, reset-clear, complete post-reset service, cache/bridge, and >=1.15x gates; converted all three B4 context assertions to tautologies; disabled the bank-request stability antecedent; and made the reset-recovery cover impossible. validate_tb_text/validate_sva_text accepted 15/15. Two controls changing BUNDLE=4 and the candidate hit ledger 36 were rejected, so the probe exercised the intended validator rather than bypassing it.
findings.risk: The exact contract SHA detects changed files but does not prove that the source checker understands the stated semantics. A successor or reviewed launch could preserve every searched token while silently dropping the very protocol/recovery/cycle obligations used to justify the unique VCS campaign.
findings.required_fix: Create an additive immutable successor to M1870. Add semantic mutations and structural validation for every escaped category: exact saved replay slot/generation/tag/payload provenance; zero replay acceptance plus sticky protocol/stale gates; both reset durations and clear gates; complete post-reset request/response/bridge/commit/terminal/cache ledgers; the >=1.15x local cycle expression; non-tautological context assertions; effective stability antecedents; and a satisfiable recovery cover. Obtain a new different-author zero-P0/P1 source hammer before authoring any release.

required_next_gate: Additive source/checker/test successor, followed by a new different-author fail-closed source hammer with P0=0 and P1=0. M1872 must not be created from M1870/M1871.
